boundaries: Reviewed PING/GET/SET/INCR/ZSCORE slice; scenario success is not full backend or provider certification.
Custom descriptors require a decoder, keys/routing and execution mode; the standalone executor rejects unsupported modes and explicit-node routing.
SET GET returns previous bytes, not an applied-status flag; typed-key writes deliberately exclude GET.
Schema JSON encoding is explicit; integer replies remain bigint and score tokens have an exact lexical API.
Handwritten family catalogs are compared with production metadata; changing a command requires reviewing both its contract and its tests.
